def longest_repeat(s):
    n = len(s)
    best = 0
    lo, hi = 0, n
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if mid == 0:
            lo = mid + 1
            continue
        seen = set()
        ok = False
        for i in range(n - mid + 1):
            sub = s[i:i + mid]
            if sub in seen:
                ok = True
                break
            seen.add(sub)
        if ok:
            best = mid
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid - 1
    return best
